tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: List design-suitable files (pages, images) in the task workspace.

tools.name: write_page
tools.description: Write a complete UTF-8 HTML page into the task workspace (path relative to workspace, must be .html/.htm). Creates or replaces the file; snapshots the previous state into .artemis/versions/.

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Targeted edit of an existing workspace HTML page: `find` must match exactly once, `content` replaces it.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Revert a workspace HTML page to the state before its latest recorded change (thin-snapshot backed). Args: { path }.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Re-apply an undone change to a workspace HTML page. Args: { path }.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Restore a historical snapshot of a workspace HTML page as the current content (the restore itself is recorded as a new snapshot). Args: { path, revision? } — revision omitted = latest snapshot.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List recorded snapshots of a workspace HTML page (oldest → newest). Args: { path }.
